ChangeRequest.name: Typo in EIL 6.5 entity name: LNG_EQTY_FND_SCRYT_PSTN_ENCMBRNC_DT
ChangeRequest.comment:
In 6.5 EIL, there is a typo in entity LNG_EQTY_FND_SCRYT_PSTN_ENCMBRNC_DT, that should instead be LNG_EQTY_FND_SCRTY_PSTN_ENCMBRNC_DT.
(i.e. ~~SCRYT~~ should be SCRTY)
